svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 120 mm disc from 10 mm plate (or buy a blank); face both

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Centre hole 30 mm, a close fit on the hub's boss.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hub screws: four 5.5 mm holes on a 40 mm circle at 45 degrees,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: countersunk from the top so the crossbar sits flat over them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Crossbar bolts: four holes drilled 5 mm and tapped M6, 45 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side of the centre and 15 mm each side of the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Homing magnet: a 6 mm hole 3 mm deep in the underside, 54 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the centre on the crossbar's centre line (glue it in).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the hub screws to its underside; the crossbar bolts to its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top; the whole turns on the azimuth shaft.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the disc runs flat within 0.3 mm at its rim when turned
